Mississippi State Senate
2026 Regular Session

    YEAS AND NAYS. The yeas and nays being taken, the Report of Conference
Committee on H. B. No. 1330 (version 2) was adopted:

       Yeas--Barnett, Barrett, Berry, Blackmon, Blackwell, Blount, Boyd, Bryan, Butler,
Carter, Chassaniol, DeBar, DeLano, DuPree, England, Fillingane, Gillespie Isom,
Harkins, Hartness, Hickman, Hopson, Jackson, Johnson, Kirby, Ladner, McCaughn,
McLendon, McMahan, Michel, Mumford, Parks, Pope, Rhodes, Seymour, Simmons D.
T. (12th), Simmons S. (13th), Sparks, Suber, Tate, Taylor, Thomas, Thompson, Turner-
Ford, Whaley, Wiggins, Williams, Younger. Total--47.
       Nays--Chism, Frazier, Norwood. Total--3.
       Absent and those not voting----None.
       Voting Present--Brumfield, Hill. Total--2.
